name: PandaSet
summary: 面向自动驾驶研究的多传感器数据集，提供相机、激光雷达、GPS/IMU 和三维标注，覆盖城市道路中的车辆、行人和交通场景。
summaryEn: A multi-sensor autonomous-driving dataset with cameras, LiDAR, GPS/IMU, and 3D annotations across urban traffic scenes.
scale: 103 eight-second scenes; 80 synchronized timesteps per scene; 6 cameras and 2 LiDARs
scaleZh: 103 个八秒场景；每场景 80 个同步时刻；6 台相机、2 台激光雷达
license: Paper reports a no-cost commercial license; obtain the release LICENSE.txt and verify its terms
licenseZh: 论文报告可免费商用；须取得发布包 LICENSE.txt 并核对具体条款
access: Original download pages are no longer reliable; current publisher download route unconfirmed
accessZh: 原下载网页已不可靠；尚未确认当前发布方下载入口
verdict: 多传感器自动驾驶数据
wmNote: 有序传感器观测与位姿可用于预测。旧 pandaset.org 在本轮检查中跳转到无关内容，Scale 的旧下载路径返回 404；不要在那里提交注册资料。当前保留原论文与开发工具来源。
wmNoteEn: Ordered sensor observations and poses support prediction. In this check the old pandaset.org domain redirected to unrelated content, and the former Scale download path returned 404. Do not submit registration details there. The original paper and devkit remain the evidence sources.

evidence.statement: Official devkit exposes sequences of sensor measurements and per-frame poses; retain sequential recordings.

yearBasis.description: Original paper Table I dates the release to 2020, although the paper was submitted in 2021.
